summary_evidence_spans: This study examined how rural secondary school students evaluate AI-generated and sample physics solutions in terms of scientific accuracy and linguistic quality.

A total of 131 students from rural schools in Kazakhstan participated in a survey in which they evaluated written responses to three conceptual physics questions and provided self-estimates of their content-related expertise.
AI-generated responses received slightly higher overall ratings than sample solutions for both scientific accuracy and linguistic quality.
These findings show that linguistic clarity and fluency may serve as important cues when students judge the scientific accuracy of AI-generated explanations.
